captions.detailed: A classic mountain artillery gun model featuring a dark olive-green wooden carriage with a split-trail design and metallic grey spades at the rear tips. A tapered dark-grey metal barrel is mounted on trunnions between the carriage walls, allowing it to pivot vertically. On each side of the carriage, a large brown spoked wheel with a dark central hub is mounted to rotate continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a mountain artillery gun with a split-trail carriage in dark olive-green, a pivoting dark-grey tapered barrel, and two large brown spoked wheels. The barrel should have a revolute joint to elevate, and both wheels should have continuous rotational joints about their axles.
captions.factory: The carriage is built from box primitives representing the side plates, crossbeams, and split-trail legs, with metallic spades at the rear. The barrel is constructed by lofting or combining cylinders of decreasing diameters, with cylindrical trunnions added perpendicular to its axis. Each spoked wheel is modeled by combining a central hub cylinder, a thin outer rim cylinder, and rectangular spokes arranged radially. Revolute joints connect the barrel trunnions to the carriage, while continuous joints link the wheels to their axle hubs.
